mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_task SET status='RUNNING',lease_owner=#{token},lease_until=#{until},attempts=attempts+1,started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND attempts<3 AND (status='PENDING' OR (status='RUNNING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))
UPDATE crawl_task SET lease_until=#{until} WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{token} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE crawl_task SET status='FAILED',error='任务重试达到上限，请检查资料或日志',finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE attempts>=3 AND status='RUNNING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM crawl_task WHERE attempts<3 AND (status='PENDING' OR (status='RUNNING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 10
